data: What is the approximate computational time for the 'theoretical' method when the size of the head cluster kh is approximately 1,000?

The question asks for the approximate computational time for the 'theoretical' method when the size of the head cluster kh is approximately 1,000. From the caption, we know that the red dotted line indicates the value of the parameter kh such that both clusters have equal probability: ph = pt = 0.5. This corresponds to the point where the theoretical curve intersects the red dotted line. By examining the graph, we can see that at approximately kh = 1,000, the theoretical curve is around 30 ms. Therefore, the approximate computational time for the 'theoretical' method when the size of the head cluster kh is approximately 1,000 is 30 ms.
